summary: Implementation plan for embedding open-source and Gemini dual-engine AI assistants into the AIS Enterprise Command Center: an NRB Diaspora Customer Simulator inside Tab 1 (WhatsApp) and an autonomous Gemini 4 Argon Co-Founder & Deal Strategist with Google Search Grounding inside Tab 2 (Cold Audit), backed by an open-source Ollama/LocalAI bridge and server-side proxy.
